status: pre-outcome lock for the publicly materializable subset of the official validation split
claim_boundary: This protocol directly compares the unchanged source-selected correction with the released PokeFlex checkpoint on all thirteen officially listed validation takes that are present in the public archive. Ten exact takes are prospectively untouched for this method; FoamDice_T3, PlushOctopus_T6, and ToiletPaperRoll_T1 are disclosed development-overlap controls. Five officially listed takes are absent from the public archive and receive no replacements. Consequently this protocol cannot reproduce or directly compare against the published eighteen-object aggregate; the published 6.498 mm value is contextual only. Jaccard is diagnostic because the public target meshes are not guaranteed volumetric under the published boolean implementation.

target_cohort.selection_basis: the exact shot/take arrays hard-coded in upstream test/evaluate.py, intersected with takes physically present in the registered public archive
target_cohort.missingness_basis: target-free public-archive inventory completed before this lock; no target mesh or score was opened
target_cohort.overlap_audit_basis: exact take-ID search over tracked Bayesian-PhysTwin source, config, result, script, test, and documentation artifacts before opening the remaining ten archives

method.state_update: robust correlation-aware graph registration at f-1
method.transfer: one material-vertex-identity step from f-1 to f
method.required_action_history: finite T_WT, T_WE, and force values for every frame used by the frozen action-local field
method.missing_required_robot_pose_action: mark update unsupported and return byte-identical released checkpoint

official_reference.paper: PokeFlex: A Real-World Dataset of Deformable Objects for Physics-Based Reconstruction
official_reference.published_split_scope: one hard-coded validation recording per each of eighteen objects
official_reference.public_subset_scope: thirteen exact official validation recordings; excludes five absent public takes without replacement

custody.template_mesh: allowed explicit task input selected by the frozen upstream robot-metadata rule
custody.prediction_frames: all contiguous f from 6 through the last robot frame; active-frame filtering occurs only during locked scoring
custody.scored_frames: force-y at f exceeds 3 N, matching the registered official evaluator
custody.retry_policy: no replacement; technical failures and exact fallbacks remain in the registered cohort

evaluation.primary_definition: mean nearest-neighbor L1 distance from deterministically sampled predicted surface points to target surface points in original metric coordinates
evaluation.aggregation: equal scored frames over the 13 publicly materializable official validation takes; object-balanced prospective values drive transfer gates
evaluation.jaccard_definition: trimesh boolean intersection volume divided by union volume
evaluation.jaccard_role: non-gating reproducibility diagnostic because the released target meshes are not guaranteed volumetric
evaluation.invalid_jaccard_action: report the failure and valid fraction; never substitute a voxel or repaired-mesh surrogate

direct_metric_reference.scope: paired candidate-versus-released-checkpoint comparison on the ten prospectively untouched public official takes

paired_transfer.bootstrap_unit: physical object among the ten prospective public official takes

forbidden: opening any campaign target deformed mesh before all thirteen prediction seals pass the barrier
using frame f Kinect or robot observations to predict frame f
substituting T_WT for missing T_WE or otherwise imputing a required actuator pose
changing the selected arm, scale, support radius, metric, aggregation, or gate after target access
replacing any of the five unavailable official takes or any failed public-subset take
tuning from any of the ten prospective take outcomes
representing the three disclosed development-overlap takes as prospective
substituting a repaired-mesh or voxel Jaccard for the registered public-mesh diagnostic
claiming reproduction of or direct comparison with the published eighteen-object aggregate
touching any held-v8 artifact or process
